generation_records.subject: Create a single ultrawide desktop wallpaper inspired by Cyberpunk 2077 and Cyberpunk Edgerunners, Night City after midnight in rain. View from a shadowy rooftop toward immense layered megabuildings, distant Arasaka tower, dense Japanese cyberpunk architecture, fine antennae and skybridges, a few restrained dim petrol-cyan and muted crimson light traces and wet roof reflections. One tiny back-facing lone mercenary silhouette in a dark jacket at the far right gives scale, not a portrait. Absolutely night-time, low-key exposure, predominantly charcoal black and midnight navy, soft distant haze, no daylight, no bright sky, no giant luminous advertisements or blazing yellow. A polished cinematic game-environment matte painting with subtle anime-influenced silhouette design, coherent architecture, rich shadow details. This is a comfortable wallpaper for working at night, NOT a bright neon poster. Compose natively for a 3440x1440 ultrawide monitor, about 2.39:1 ratio, with the architectural focal point in the right half, quiet dark left third, entire continuous landscape, no panels, no borders, no readable text, no typography, no logos, no watermark.

Create one extremely panoramic dark desktop wallpaper inspired by the outskirts of Night City in Cyberpunk 2077 / Edgerunners. A sleek futuristic low black motorcycle with a small dim red rear light parked at lower right on a rain-wet elevated expressway, no rider, looking toward a long low distant Night City skyline through black indigo haze. The view travels horizontally across the frame, low horizon, controlled burgundy and petrol cyan pinpoints, faint distant transmission towers, subtle puddle reflections. Native composition for a very wide shallow 2560x720 monitor (3.56:1): keep ALL important features within the middle horizontal 38 percent band of the canvas so an extreme panoramic crop retains the complete motorcycle, road and skyline. Elegant cinematic environment illustration, convincing vehicle engineering, quiet melancholic atmosphere, over 85 percent dark blue-black negative space, tiny neon accents only, no broad luminous sky or moon, no bright billboards, no white surfaces, no text, logos, border or watermark. Comfortable night work wallpaper, match a restrained midnight navy / smoky cyan / desaturated red palette.

Create an original vertical-ish desktop wallpaper of Lucy (Lucyna Kushinada) from the Netflix anime Cyberpunk Edgerunners in a quiet rooftop moment at night, not a copy of any existing frame. Recognizable young adult Lucy with short asymmetrical pale silver bob and subtle pastel ends, dark netrunner suit and short pale jacket mostly in shadow, shown from behind in three-quarter profile gazing over Night City. Position her as a medium-small figure in the lower-right half, her complete head and shoulders comfortably inside the frame, anatomically natural, hands hidden behind rooftop parapet, not a face closeup. Towering dark megastructures rise vertically, a faint thin moon high above behind deep indigo cloud, fine muted cyan and dusty magenta lights far below. Authentic crisp anime background painting, thoughtful cel shading, atmospheric depth and beautiful restrained linework, deeply melancholic cinematic mood. Native portrait composition designed for a 1600x1800 almost-square vertical monitor: safe central width, no key subject at top or bottom edges. Very dark low-key treatment, graphite and midnight navy dominate, hair silver-gray NOT glowing white, jacket shaded gray, only subtle colored rim lighting, no large bright yellow or white areas, no big glowing moon. No lettering, subtitles, UI, panels, border, logo or watermark.

Create a dedicated terminal application background inspired by Night City in Cyberpunk 2077 and Cyberpunk Edgerunners. A nearly black charcoal-indigo rainy rooftop vista, with a tiny distant futuristic city skyline and delicate dim cyan and dusty crimson architectural edge lights concentrated only at the far right and bottom-right edges. Across the LEFT 75 PERCENT and central upper region, almost featureless matte near-black navy atmospheric negative space is mandatory so dense white terminal code will remain comfortably legible. Architecture is present as subtle low-contrast ghosted silhouettes, not a black rectangle pasted on a busy image. The entire scene should have very compressed dark tonal values: visual mean around RGB 10-15, accent highlights no brighter than dark slate, zero bright whites, zero glowing signage, no readable text, no characters, no logos, no close foreground objects, no large central subject, no border, no watermark. Artful quiet midnight anime-meets-cinematic-game environment illustration, subtle atmospheric haze, sparse controlled detail. Landscape 3:2 composition, designed for cover cropping aligned right center inside resizable Tern terminal panes. This is the dark companion to a midnight navy / muted cyan / desaturated crimson Cyberpunk wallpaper collection, more subdued than the desktop images, not a poster and not a terminal screenshot.

From left edge through 75 percent width is an unbroken nearly uniform dark field. Keep center completely empty. No horizontal cyan line across image, no floor grid, no center glow. The scene should remain minimal when the leftmost fifth is cropped away by right-aligned cover.
request.lighting: Extremely low-key nearly black navy palette. Cyan lines are dim, thin and sparse, very slight bloom only, absolutely no white light, no amber, no colorful fog, no high-frequency texture, no reflections across the middle. Contrast confined to far right.
request.style: Photorealistic restrained polished obsidian science-fiction architecture in the visual language of TRON: Legacy, premium dark cinematic material realism, deliberately subordinate to readable terminal text.
request.text: No actual code, no text, no letters, no numbers, no glyphs, no logos, no watermarks, no interface, no screen, no borders.

generation_records.subject: Create an exceptionally beautiful desktop wallpaper inspired by Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, an emotionally resonant anime cinematic environment painting, NOT a poster. Night City seen from a rain-wet rooftop far above the city, a vast layered skyline of elegant dense megastructures, elevated railways, cyan window constellations, distant magenta neon and a pale enormous moon through violet haze. Two small recognizable rear-view figures, David Martinez in his iconic yellow high-collar jacket and Lucy with short white hair in her black-and-white netrunner outfit, quietly sit side by side on a rooftop ledge in the right third, gazing across the city. Their scale is small, about 16 percent of image height; architecture and atmosphere are the main subjects. Beautiful melancholy, intimacy against impossible urban scale, not violence. Design for a VERY WIDE 3440x1440 wallpaper crop: keep ALL important subjects including the figures, moon and primary skyline INSIDE THE CENTRAL 60 PERCENT OF THE IMAGE HEIGHT, with sky above and rooftop shadow below as expendable crop margins. Keep the left quarter relatively calm and dark for desktop icons. Distinct architecture, believable perspective, delicate distant lights, controlled bloom, refined atmospheric depth, crisp silhouettes, luxurious visual hierarchy. Cohesive series palette: deep midnight navy and indigo, electric turquoise, restrained hot pink, small warm amber-yellow accents. Beautiful cel-shaded anime characters integrated into detailed painterly anime background art. No typography, no letters, no logos, no watermarks, no borders, no collage, no split panels.

Create a new cinematic anime desktop wallpaper for the EXTREMELY WIDE 2560x720 Corsair XENEON EDGE monitor, part of a coordinated Cyberpunk: Edgerunners inspired collection. Image 1 is a STYLE AND PALETTE reference only: inherit its midnight navy, violet mist, cyan architectural lighting, restrained magenta and warm yellow accents, detailed painterly anime background and crisp cel shading. Do NOT copy its composition or the seated characters. New scene: a beautiful low-slung yellow retrofuturist sports coupe seen in clean side/rear three-quarter view on the left third of an elevated rain-wet expressway, tiny red tail lights, glossy asphalt reflecting long turquoise and magenta streaks. The expressway sweeps gently across the scene into a huge distant night city, dark mountain silhouettes and violet atmospheric haze, a small pale moon in the far right sky. Compose for a long cinematic horizontal ribbon, quiet and elegant rather than crowded. CRITICAL CROP SAFETY: all of the car, road bend, moon and luminous skyline must fit inside a horizontal strip from 30 to 70 percent of the image height; the whole car is small, no more than 15 percent of image height. Upper 30 percent is spare navy sky, lower 30 percent is dark expendable road foreground. No tall important foreground objects. The final 3.56:1 crop will remove the top and bottom. Impossibly beautiful reflective light, believable car wheels and perspective, carefully controlled glow, architectural depth, melancholy night drive. No humans, no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no collage, no panel divisions.

Create an exceptionally beautiful fine-art anime desktop wallpaper inspired by Lucy from Cyberpunk: Edgerunners, for a 1600x1800 almost-square portrait LG DualUp monitor. Image 1 is the STYLE AND PALETTE reference only: inherit its midnight indigo, violet atmosphere, turquoise city lights, restrained hot pink, pale lilac moonlight, crisp cel shading integrated with detailed painterly anime architectural backgrounds. Do not duplicate its two-character scene. A new intimate contemplative composition: Lucy, recognizable short asymmetrical white hair with subtle pastel cyan and pink edges, black and white futuristic netrunner outfit and cropped white jacket, standing in side profile facing left on a rain-wet rooftop balcony, looking up toward an enormous luminous pale lilac moon behind thin drifting violet clouds. One person only, elegant relaxed fully plausible anatomy, both arms relaxed and hands unobtrusive. Lucy is placed in the lower-right half; frame her from head to mid-thigh with the bottom edge intentionally at mid-thigh rather than accidentally cutting feet. Her figure takes about one third of image width. An immense layered night city falls away below, tiny cyan windows, wisps of rooftop steam, a few glowing magenta accents. Moon upper left, character lower right, architectural verticals balanced by ample calm dark sky. Important composition inside the central 74 percent of image HEIGHT, allowing a crop to near-square 8:9. Hair and moon must not be cut by the crop, no crucial details at top or bottom edge. Refined cinematic lighting: soft lunar rim on white hair and coat, delicate cyan reflected light, deep beautiful indigo shadows with readable detail. Quiet longing and wonder, not fan-service, no pin-up pose. No typography, no letters, no logos, no watermark, no borders, no collage.
